Independent type foundry founded by Sam Glen Hughes (credited as Sam G. Hughes) in 2019, still active and releasing typefaces (Sometimes Times, Office Times, Oatmeal Pro, Lothian Sans, Kale Sans, BL Melody, BL Pylon, Helium Serif). Own site states based in Victoria, Canada (also on Behance as Canada), though its Facebook page lists Edinburgh and several typeface names (Lothian, Murrayfield) suggest Scottish roots, so treat the country as hedged. Founder-led, likely small/solo practice despite calling itself a collaborative studio; also runs a newer parallel storefront at boulevardtype.com. No LinkedIn company page found after search.

Work captured 2026-07-26: specimen images for 9 named typefaces across both sites. From boulevardlab.com (cargo.site, current catalog): George Neue, Kale Mono, Sometimes Times, Lothian Sans, Office Times (2 specimen images each, full res via freight.cargo.site CDN). From boulevardtype.com (Webflow "BetaLAB" beta-release page, live at www.boulevardtype.com; the bare apex domain has a broken TLS handshake and refuses connections from curl/Playwright/WebFetch alike, use the www subdomain): Cereal, Orchid, Helium Serif, Murrayfield. These specimens render as live text set in the actual webfont rather than static images, so they were captured as cropped Playwright screenshots of each typeface's own catalog block. Website context shot taken. Instagram profile screenshot (@boulevard___lab) was throttled twice (logged-out IG served a "Something went wrong" error page both tries); queued to state/ig-queue.json for a later logged-in ig.py pass, not shipped as a broken capture.
